'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Kyiv offensive (2022)|Kyiv offensive]]
****[[Battle of Kyiv (2022)|Battle of Kyiv]]
*****[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] say that they have retaken [[Makariv]], a suburb near [[Kyiv]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-europe-60830013?ns_mchannel=social&ns_source=twitter&ns_campaign=bbc_live&ns_linkname=62394a221fea84616a6cc58a%26Ukraine%20military%20claims%20it%20has%20retaken%20town%20near%20Kyiv%262022-03-22T04%3A39%3A56%2B00%3A00&ns_fee=0&pinned_post_locator=urn:asset:3f261c49-5d13-461a-b27e-59aadbce06f2&pinned_post_asset_id=62394a221fea84616a6cc58a&pinned_post_type=share (BBC News)]
***[[Siege of Mariupol]]
****[[Russian Navy]] warships in the [[Sea of Azov]] shell Ukrainian-held areas of [[Mariupol]]. [https://news.abplive.com/news/world/russian-ships-shelling-port-city-of-mariupol-1521135 (ABP Live)]
***[[Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
****[[Secretary-General of the United Nations|UN Secretary-General]] [[António Guterres]] says that there is diplomatic progress on several key issues in the situation in [[Ukraine]] in an effort to end the "unwinnable" war. [https://news.un.org/en/story/2022/03/1114392 (United Nations)]
***[[Nuclear risk during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Nuclear risk during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
****[[Kremlin Press Secretary]] [[Dmitry Peskov]] says that Russia will only use its [[Russia and weapons of mass destruction|nuclear weapons]] if the country faces an "existential threat" amid growing concerns that Russia will use nuclear weapons in Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/kremlin-russia-would-only-use-nuclear-weapons-if-its-existence-were-threatened-2022-03-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Beersheba attack]]
**Four people are killed and two others are injured during a [[vehicle-ramming attack|vehicle-ramming]] and [[mass stabbing]] attack in [[Beersheba]], [[Southern District (Israel)|Southern]] [[Israel]]. The attacker, an [[Islamic State]] supporter, was shot dead by a bus driver. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/four-wounded-two-critically-in-stabbing-attack-in-southern-israel-1.10690995 (''Haaretz'')]
'''Arts and culture'''
*Five [[Ancient Egypt]]ian [[tomb]]s are discovered in [[Egypt]]. [https://www.jpost.com/archaeology/article-702010 (''Jerusalem Post'')]
'''Business and economy'''
*[[Boycott of Russia and Belarus]]
**[[Denmark|Danish]] shipping company [[Maersk]] announces its complete withdrawal from the [[Economy of Russia|Russian economy]] and says that it will liquidate all of its Russian assets. [https://trans.info/en/russia-maersk-281292 (Trans.info)]
**[[LG Electronics]] suspends all shipments to Russia and says that the company "remains committed to supporting [[humanitarian]] relief efforts". [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2022/03/22/LG-Electronics-suspsends-shipments-Russia/8351647953593/ (UPI)]
**[[France|French]] oil and natural gas company [[TotalEnergies]] announces that it will no longer buy Russian oil by the end of the year and will also terminate additional investments in Russia. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/03/22/business/total-energies-russia-oil.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia–Ukraine relations]]
***[[Kremlin Press Secretary]] [[Dmitry Peskov]] says that the ongoing ceasefire talks should be "more active and substantial". [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2022/03/22/kremlin-calls-for-more-substantial-talks-on-ukraine-a77032 (''The Moscow Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*Eight people are killed in [[2022 Birbhum violence|an arson attack]] in [[Birbhum]], [[West Bengal]], India. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/other-states/six-women-two-children-burnt-to-death-in-bengals-birbhum-after-trinamool-leaders-murder/article65248532.ece (The Hindu)]
*Two teachers are killed by a student during a [[stabbing]] attack at a [[secondary school]] in [[Malmö]], [[Sweden]]. The perpetrator, an 18-year-old boy, is arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-60830059 (BBC News)]
*[[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia|Russian opposition leader]] [[Alexei Navalny]] is convicted of [[fraud]] and sentenced to nine years in prison by a Russian court, which claims that Navalny stole millions in donations from his supporters. [https://news.sky.com/story/alexei-navalny-kremlin-critic-found-guilty-of-large-scale-fraud-by-russian-court-12572292 (Sky News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[44th Canadian Parliament]]
**[[Prime Minister of Canada|Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] announces that the [[Liberal Party of Canada|Liberal Party]] has finalized a [[confidence and supply|confidence-and-supply agreement]] with the [[New Democratic Party]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/politics/liberals-ndp-agree-to-confidence-deal-seeing-trudeau-government-maintain-power-until-2025-1.5829116 (CTV News)] 

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Australia]] announces the creation of the [[Australian Defence Space Command|Defence Space command]], saying it is designed to counter Russia and [[Mainland China]]'s ambitions in [[outer space]]. The new agency's servicemembers will come from the [[Australian Army|army]], [[Royal Australian Navy|navy]], [[Royal Australian Air Force|air force]], and will also include [[private contractor]]s.  [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-60835136 (BBC News)]
